directories.description: The working document of the DTH on health supply chain architecture: its document, chapters and blocks, seeded from the L1 entry who-iris/library/9789240101197-eng by its contents-page outline.

The handbook's supply chain terms as a folio-glossary/v1 SKOS scheme. Each term quotes the handbook's definition with its L1 page, and links to the smart-ra concept it narrows or matches. General digital terms are held in smart-ra, not here.
Inbox for material not yet ingested.
This instance's work plan — one Markdown file per bean, managed with the `beans` CLI (`.beans.yml`).

description: WHO Digital transformation handbook for health supply chain architecture (ISBN 9789240101197), as an L2 DTH on smart-ra: the working document folio seeded from its L1 entry in who-iris, and its supply chain glossary linked to the smart-ra glossary and ArchiMate model. dth-pc and dth-sfp depend on it.
